item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】FLAC - Fall Out Boy - "The Take Over, The Breaks Over" (Dolby Atmos Stereo Downmix) [16bit-48kHz] (2007)
item.description:
Genre: Pop punk
Release date: 2007

I love this song but i'm quite dissapointed with the amount of compression on it. Luckily the Dolby Atmos version sounds much more clearer so i downsampled it to stereo. The surround channel version of this song has a missing guitar solo but there's a stem of it from Rock Band, i think? I just added it back in and it sounds stunning. Way better in my opinion. I can hear details that were drowned in the mix.
